scope: Public moving, service and initial quote-entry pages.

metrics.label: Company-reported moves since 2005
metrics.context: Reported on the company website; not independently audited.

metrics.label: Website-displayed review summary
metrics.context: Website reports 2,100+ reviews; the live platform count was not independently verified.

observations.title: Make comparison claims easy to verify
observations.observed: The homepage compares its rating with an asserted industry average and shows a "typical mover" fee comparison, without a methodology or dated supporting source beside the reviewed blocks.
observations.improvement: Add the basis, date and scope for comparisons, or lead with the company's published inclusions. Link review and recognition statements to their sources.

observations.title: Proofread the testimonial-card presentation
observations.observed: Several homepage testimonial cards contain sentence fragments, including a standalone "They." before the next sentence.
observations.improvement: Check the template and source excerpts. Restore complete sentences without changing meaning; link originals where permission and platform rules allow.

limitations: Only the initial quote step was inspected. Later steps, actual prices, booking confirmation and guarantee operation were not tested.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
